value.rationale: Minimum cycle-breaking configurations for a canonical symmetric cubic bipartite graph provide a naturally constrained reconfiguration problem. The known scalar decycling number does not determine its 672-state solution space. The complete classification exposes nontrivial behavior: both unrestricted and strictly adjacent moves retain reachability, but jumping is self-centered (radius=diameter=5), while sliding produces radius 7, diameter 9 and exactly 16 peripheral configurations. The exact swap edge counts, degree and eccentricity distributions are useful for deciding and bounding optimal transformations in this instance. This is structurally motivated finite exact information, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
